info.title: FINBRIDGE API
info.description: FINBRIDGE: AI-Powered Inclusive Micro-Lending & Financial Intelligence Platform. Core: FT-03 Secure Micro-Lending with Alternative Credit Assessment.

get.description:
Liveness probe.

Returns a simple status object confirming the API is running.

schema.title: Response Health Check Api V1 Health Get

post.description: Call this **after** Firebase creates the account on the client. Pass the Firebase ID token + user details. Returns the created user.

post.summary: Verify Firebase token and return user info
post.description: Pass the Firebase ID token obtained from `getIdToken()`. Returns the user record from the FINBRIDGE database.

get.description: Returns the currently authenticated user's profile.
Returns the authenticated user's business profile.

put.description: Partially update the authenticated user's business profile. Only provided fields are updated.

post.description: Create an MSME business profile for the authenticated user. Each user can have only one profile (409 if already exists).
Submits a borrowing request for the authenticated MSME business.

post.summary: Assess loan request and produce prototype recommendation
post.description: Evaluates borrowing parameters against the MSME's Financial Trust Score, net cash flow, expense discipline, and fraud telemetry. Returns sustainable loan bounds, reducing-balance EMI, repayment burden, and over-borrowing cautions.
Simulates loan parameters (amount, tenure, interest rate) in real-time against the business's actual cash flow surplus. Calculates EMI, repayment burden %, and over-borrowing risk.

post.summary: Simulate parameters for a specific loan application

get.summary: List loan applications for current business

schema.title: Response List Loan Applications Api V1 Loans Applications Get

post.summary: Assess business credit & generate Financial Trust Score
post.description: Executes the FT-03 Alternative Credit Assessment Engine. Extracts deterministic features across stability, cash flow, consistency, expense discipline, repayment capacity, transaction behaviour, and fraud signals. Returns explainable 0-100 Financial Trust Score with metric-backed factors.

get.summary: Get current Financial Trust Score & Credit Profile
get.description: Retrieves the latest Financial Trust Profile for the authenticated business. If no assessment exists yet, automatically performs an initial assessment.

get.summary: Get credit score by business ID
get.description: Fetches latest credit score profile for the given business ID.

post.description: Accept a CSV file with columns: date, description, amount, type, merchant. Validates, normalises, categorises, and bulk-inserts valid rows. Returns a summary of accepted and rejected rows.

get.summary: List transactions for the authenticated business

get.description: Returns aggregated financial metrics: monthly revenue, expenses, net cash flow, expense ratio, revenue consistency, and cash-flow volatility. All values computed server-side.
Returns month-by-month credit, debit, and net values.
Returns per-category expense totals and percentage share of total spend.
Returns per-month revenue aggregates for the revenue trend chart.

post.summary: Run fraud/risk analysis on all transactions
post.description: Runs the FT-02 hybrid risk engine (rule engine + Isolation Forest) on every transaction for the authenticated business. Creates or updates a FraudAlert for each transaction. Returns a summary of analyzed and risk-leveled counts.

schema.title: Response Run Fraud Analysis Api V1 Fraud Analyze Post

get.summary: List fraud alerts for the authenticated business
get.description: Returns paginated fraud alerts sorted by risk score descending. Optionally filter by risk_level (LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH). Each alert includes the embedded transaction details.
Returns total transaction count, number analyzed, and counts + percentages for LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH risk levels. Powers the stats row on the /fraud-alerts dashboard.
Returns a catalog of all active government schemes.

schema.title: Response List Schemes Api V1 Schemes Get

get.summary: Get scheme matches for the user's business
get.description: Runs the fuzzy matching engine against the user's MSME profile and returns prioritized recommendations.

post.description: Explains actual financial data generated by our deterministic backend. The AI Coach is provided with structured business context: revenue, expenses, net cash flow, expense ratio, trust score, fraud risk, and loan metrics. Supported questions include loan affordability, score drivers, fraud flags, and financial concepts like EMI and repayment burden.

get.summary: Get structured financial context for current business
Get 7 contextual educational financial literacy cards
get.description: Returns curated lesson cards covering Cash Flow, EMI, Interest, Repayment Burden, Revenue Consistency, Expense Management, and Transaction Risk.

post.summary: Explain why a transaction was flagged
